source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "platform urbanism" OR "platform urbanisation" OR "platform urbanization" OR "platform cities"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"platform urbanism" OR "platform urbanisation" OR "platform urbanization" OR "platform cities",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("platform cities" OR "platform urbanisation" OR "platform urbanism" OR "platform urbanization")
